title: Escape spreadsheet formulas in the audit CSV export
spec: Cells that start with =, +, - or @ must be prefixed with a single quote before they are written.
acceptance_criteria: values starting with =, +, - or @ are prefixed with a single quote
a unit test covers every prefix character
pr_body: Adds csvCell and tests. All green.

defects.note: no case for a value starting with @
